documentDetail.reviewDescription: Compare the extracted details with the original report. Confirm only if they look accurate; unconfirmed details are kept out of health insights, Lumi, reminders, the timeline, and exports. If something is wrong, reject this extraction and upload a clearer copy.
documentDetail.rejectConfirm: Reject these extracted details? They will be removed from your health record. You can upload a clearer copy later.
documentDetail.confirmedStatus: Reviewed and confirmed. These details can now appear in your health record.
documentDetail.rejectedStatus: This extraction was rejected and its extracted health details were removed.
documentDetail.originalUnavailable: The original document could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry before confirming.

documentDetail.summaryAfterReview: Confirm the reviewed details to open the summary.

documentDetail.injuriesTitle: Fractures and injuries reported in this document

assistant.name: Lumi
assistant.description: Ask health questions in your language.
assistant.specialty: Focused on health questions, allergies, medicines, and understanding medical reports.
assistant.title: Your multilingual health assistant
assistant.intro: Ask about health concerns, allergies, medicines, or your results in English, Hindi, Telugu, or Tamil. Lumi remembers this chat and uses relevant things you have shared—along with your saved health details—to answer future questions.
assistant.welcome: What would you like help understanding?
assistant.disclaimer: Lumi shares general health information, not a diagnosis. Your chat is saved to this health profile and may contain sensitive information. You can review it here and permanently delete it at any time.
assistant.promptAllergy: Could these symptoms be an allergic reaction?
assistant.promptMedicine: Could my allergy be related to a medicine?
assistant.promptResults: Help me understand a recent test result.
assistant.placeholder: Type your question in English, Hindi, Telugu, or Tamil…
assistant.confirmClear: Permanently delete all Lumi chats saved to this health profile?
assistant.reportProcessing: Your report is being processed. When ready, you can discuss it with Lumi or review the extracted details before adding it to your health record.
assistant.reportStillProcessing: This report is taking longer than expected. It will appear in the timeline when processing finishes.
assistant.reportReady: Your report was processed. Review the extracted details before confirming it to update your health timeline and summary.
assistant.reportQuestion: Please explain the report I just uploaded. Clearly distinguish what the report says from what is uncertain, and do not diagnose me.
assistant.reportFailed: We couldn't process that report. Please try again with a clear medical report.
assistant.imageQuestion: Please look at the attached image and share general health information.
assistant.imageNote: Images, including X-rays, are sent only for this question and are not saved. Lumi can offer general observations, not a diagnosis or definitive scan reading. Use a clinician or radiologist’s report for interpretation. Upload medical reports separately to add them to your timeline.
assistant.invalidImage: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
assistant.imageLimit: Attach up to 2 images, each under 4 MB (8 MB total).
assistant.voiceLanguageHint: Voice input and spoken replies follow your preferred language setting.
assistant.vitalsReviewPrompt: Please review my recent saved vital readings. Explain any notable patterns, tell me what information is missing, and say when I should contact a clinician. Treat device readings as potentially inaccurate; do not diagnose or infer an emergency from a reading alone.
assistant.voiceUnavailable: Voice input is not supported by this browser.
assistant.voiceTranslationUnavailable: The written reply is available, but its spoken-language translation could not be prepared.
assistant.voiceError: Voice input stopped. Check microphone permission and try again.
assistant.voicePreferenceError: Your spoken-reply preference could not be saved in this browser.
assistant.summaryTranslationFailed: This summary could not be translated right now. Please try again later.
assistant.error: We couldn't get a response. Please try again.
assistant.reminderProposalError: Lumi couldn't prepare a reminder suggestion. You can add one from the Reminders page.
assistant.emergency: If you have trouble breathing, swelling of your face, tongue or throat, fainting, or rapidly worsening symptoms, call local emergency services now. Do not wait for a chat response.
